candidates.titulo: Apple says more ex-employees may have taken confidential data to OpenAI
candidates.resumen: Apple says its trade secrets investigation into OpenAI has widened. In a new court filing, Apple claims additional former staff may have retained or accessed confidential information.

candidates.titulo: AWS is helping vibe-coding startup Superblocks, and the implications are big
candidates.resumen: AWS now allows vibe-coding tool Superblocks to be embedded into the private clouds of AWS customers. It's another step toward decoupling apps from models.

candidates.titulo: Meet Wrinkles, an app that uncovers the hidden stories of the places around you
candidates.resumen: Wrinkles, available on both iOS and Android, essentially acts as an AI-powered audio tour guide that reveals hidden history and local stories.
